mapper.sql: s.id,s.course_id,s.creator_id,s.slug,s.title,s.subtitle,s.description,s.topic, s.cover_tone,s.status,s.featured,s.preview_section_id,s.preview_minutes,c.price,c.free, s.liked_times,s.view_times, s.blocked,(s.status='published' AND c.status=2 AND s.blocked=0) AS available, (c.id IS NOT NULL) AS previously_published,(cr.owner_user_id=#{userId}) AS creator_owned, CASE WHEN c.free=1 THEN 0 ELSE s.unlock_points END AS unlock_points, cr.display_name AS creator_name,cr.slug AS creator_slug, cr.initials AS creator_initials,cr.avatar_color AS creator_color, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM course_catalogue e WHERE e.course_id=c.id AND e.type=2 AND e.media_id>0 AND e.deleted=0) AS episode_count, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(e.media_duration),0) FROM course_catalogue e WHERE e.course_id=c.id AND e.type=2 AND e.media_id>0 AND e.deleted=0) AS duration, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM learntrail_watchlist w WHERE w.series_id=s.id AND w.user_id=#{userId}) AS saved
FROM learntrail_series s JOIN course c ON c.id=s.course_id JOIN learntrail_creator cr ON cr.id=s.creator_id WHERE c.deleted=0
mapper.select:
SELECT AND (s.status='published' OR (#{includeDraft}=1 AND cr.owner_user_id=#{userId}))
AND (s.title LIKE CONCAT('%',#{q},'%') OR s.subtitle LIKE CONCAT('%',#{q},'%') OR cr.display_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{q},'%'))
AND s.topic=#{topic} AND cr.slug=#{creator} AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM learntrail_watchlist w WHERE w.series_id=s.id AND w.user_id=#{userId}) ORDER BY s.featured DESC,s.sort_order,s.id LIMIT 100
mapper.sql:
FROM learntrail_series s JOIN learntrail_creator cr ON cr.id=s.creator_id LEFT JOIN course c ON c.id=s.course_id AND c.deleted=0 WHERE
1=1 c.id IS NOT NULL
AND c.id IN #{courseId}
AND 1=0
AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM learntrail_watchlist w WHERE w.series_id=s.id AND w.user_id=#{userId})
AND c.status=2 AND s.status='published' AND s.blocked=0
AND (s.title LIKE CONCAT('%',#{query.q},'%') OR s.subtitle LIKE CONCAT('%',#{query.q},'%') OR cr.display_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{query.q},'%'))
AND s.topic=#{query.topic} AND cr.slug=#{query.creator}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*)
SELECT DISTINCT s.topic AND s.status='published' ORDER BY s.topic

SELECT c.id AS course_id,c.free,COALESCE(s.blocked,0) AS blocked, (c.status=2 AND (s.id IS NULL OR (s.status='published' AND s.blocked=0))) AS available, (cr.owner_user_id=#{userId}) AS creator_owned FROM course c LEFT JOIN learntrail_series s ON s.course_id=c.id LEFT JOIN learntrail_creator cr ON cr.id=s.creator_id WHERE c.id=#{courseId} AND c.deleted=0
SELECT AND s.id=#{id}AND s.slug=#{slug}
SELECT s.unlock_points AND s.course_id=#{courseId} AND s.status='published' AND c.free=0 AND s.unlock_points>0
mapper.sql: cr.*, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM learntrail_series s JOIN course c ON c.id=s.course_id WHERE s.creator_id=cr.id AND s.status='published' AND s.blocked=0 AND c.status=2 AND c.deleted=0) AS series_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM learntrail_creator_follow f WHERE f.creator_id=cr.id) AS follower_count, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM learntrail_creator_follow f WHERE f.creator_id=cr.id AND f.user_id=#{userId}) AS following
mapper.select: SELECT FROM learntrail_creator cr ORDER BY cr.id LIMIT 100
mapper.sql:
SELECT ,
CASE cr.owner_user_id WHEN #{author} THEN #{count} ELSE 0 END
0 AS article_count FROM learntrail_creator cr WHERE cr.display_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{q},'%') OR cr.headline LIKE CONCAT('%',#{q},'%')
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM () ranked WHERE series_count + article_count > 0
SELECT FROM learntrail_creator cr WHERE cr.slug=#{slug}
SELECT FROM learntrail_creator cr WHERE cr.owner_user_id=#{userId}
SELECT user_id,created_at AS followed_at FROM learntrail_creator_follow WHERE creator_id=#{creatorId} ORDER BY created_at DESC,user_id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO learntrail_creator (id,owner_user_id,slug,display_name,headline,bio,initials) VALUES (#{id},#{userId},CONCAT('creator-',#{id}),#{profile.displayName},#{profile.headline},#{profile.bio},#{initials}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id=learntrail_creator.id
mapper.select: SELECT s.id,s.course_id,s.creator_id,s.slug,s.title,s.subtitle,s.description,s.topic, s.cover_tone,s.status,d.price,d.free,d.third_cate_id AS category_id, CASE WHEN d.free=1 THEN 0 ELSE s.unlock_points END AS unlock_points, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM course_catalogue_draft e WHERE e.course_id=d.id AND e.type=2 AND e.deleted=0) AS episode_count FROM learntrail_series s JOIN learntrail_creator cr ON cr.id=s.creator_id JOIN course_draft d ON d.id=s.course_id AND d.deleted=0 WHERE cr.owner_user_id=#{userId} AND s.status='draft' ORDER BY s.updated_at DESC,s.id DESC

SELECT s.id,s.course_id,s.creator_id,s.slug,s.title,s.subtitle,s.description,s.topic, s.cover_tone,s.status,s.blocked,s.draft_payload, (c.id IS NOT NULL) AS previously_published,(cr.owner_user_id=#{userId}) AS creator_owned, (s.status='published' AND c.status=2 AND s.blocked=0) AS available, CASE WHEN s.status='draft' THEN s.draft_preview_section_id ELSE s.preview_section_id END AS preview_section_id, CASE WHEN s.status='draft' THEN s.draft_preview_minutes ELSE s.preview_minutes END AS preview_minutes, COALESCE(d.price,c.price) AS price,COALESCE(d.free,c.free) AS free, COALESCE(d.third_cate_id,c.third_cate_id) AS category_id, CASE WHEN COALESCE(d.free,c.free)=1 THEN 0 ELSE s.unlock_points END AS unlock_points FROM learntrail_series s JOIN learntrail_creator cr ON cr.id=s.creator_id LEFT JOIN course_draft d ON d.id=s.course_id AND d.deleted=0 LEFT JOIN course c ON c.id=s.course_id AND c.deleted=0 WHERE (#{userId} IS NULL OR cr.owner_user_id=#{userId}) AND s.id=#{id} FOR UPDATE

SELECT s.id,s.course_id,s.creator_id,s.slug,s.title,s.subtitle,s.description,s.topic,s.cover_tone, s.status,s.blocked,s.draft_payload,(c.id IS NOT NULL) AS previously_published,1 AS creator_owned, (s.status='published' AND c.status=2 AND s.blocked=0) AS available, COALESCE(d.price,c.price) AS price,COALESCE(d.free,c.free) AS free, COALESCE(d.third_cate_id,c.third_cate_id) AS category_id, CASE WHEN COALESCE(d.free,c.free)=1 THEN 0 ELSE s.unlock_points END AS unlock_points, CASE WHEN s.status='draft' THEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM course_catalogue_draft e WHERE e.course_id=s.course_id AND e.type=2 AND e.deleted=0) ELSE (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM course_catalogue e WHERE e.course_id=s.course_id AND e.type=2 AND e.deleted=0) END AS episode_count FROM learntrail_series s JOIN learntrail_creator cr ON cr.id=s.creator_id LEFT JOIN course_draft d ON d.id=s.course_id AND d.deleted=0 LEFT JOIN course c ON c.id=s.course_id AND c.deleted=0 WHERE cr.owner_user_id=#{userId} ORDER BY s.updated_at DESC,s.id DESC
SELECT id FROM course_catalogue_draft WHERE course_id=#{courseId} AND type=1 AND deleted=0 ORDER BY c_index,id LIMIT 1

SELECT e.media_id FROM course_catalogue_draft e JOIN learntrail_series s ON s.course_id=e.course_id JOIN learntrail_creator cr ON cr.id=s.creator_id WHERE e.course_id=#{courseId} AND cr.owner_user_id=#{userId} AND e.deleted=0 AND e.media_id>0 UNION SELECT e.media_id FROM course_catalogue e JOIN learntrail_series s ON s.course_id=e.course_id JOIN learntrail_creator cr ON cr.id=s.creator_id WHERE e.course_id=#{courseId} AND cr.owner_user_id=#{userId} AND e.deleted=0 AND e.media_id>0
SELECT id,media_id,name AS title,video_name AS filename,media_duration AS duration FROM course_catalogue_draft WHERE course_id=#{courseId} AND type=2 AND deleted=0 ORDER BY c_index,id
mapper.update: UPDATE learntrail_series SET draft_preview_section_id=#{sectionId,jdbcType=BIGINT},draft_preview_minutes=#{minutes} WHERE id=#{id} AND status='draft'

UPDATE learntrail_series SET status='published',title=#{edit.title},subtitle=#{edit.subtitle}, description=#{edit.description},topic=#{edit.topic},cover_tone=#{edit.coverTone},unlock_points=#{unlockPoints}, preview_section_id=draft_preview_section_id,preview_minutes=draft_preview_minutes,draft_payload=NULL WHERE id=#{id} AND status='draft' AND blocked=0

UPDATE learntrail_series s JOIN learntrail_creator cr ON cr.id=s.creator_id SET s.draft_payload=#{payload},s.updated_at=NOW() WHERE s.id=#{id} AND cr.owner_user_id=#{userId} AND s.status='draft' AND s.blocked=0

UPDATE learntrail_series s JOIN learntrail_creator cr ON cr.id=s.creator_id SET s.status='draft',s.draft_payload=#{payload},s.draft_preview_section_id=s.preview_section_id, s.draft_preview_minutes=COALESCE(s.preview_minutes,3) WHERE s.id=#{id} AND cr.owner_user_id=#{userId} AND s.status IN ('published','unlisted','archived') AND s.blocked=0
UPDATE learntrail_series s JOIN learntrail_creator cr ON cr.id=s.creator_id SET s.status=#{state} WHERE s.id=#{id} AND cr.owner_user_id=#{userId} AND s.blocked=0
UPDATE learntrail_series SET blocked=#{blocked} WHERE id=#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT e.id,e.name AS title,e.media_duration AS duration,e.c_index AS position, (e.trailer=1 OR e.id=s.preview_section_id OR c.free=1) AS preview FROM course_catalogue e JOIN course c ON c.id=e.course_id JOIN learntrail_series s ON s.course_id=c.id LEFT JOIN course_catalogue chapter ON chapter.id=e.parent_catalogue_id WHERE e.course_id=#{courseId} AND e.deleted=0 AND e.type=2 AND e.media_id>0 ORDER BY COALESCE(chapter.c_index,0),e.c_index,e.id

SELECT c.free,s.preview_section_id,s.preview_minutes,s.blocked, (s.status='published' AND c.status=2 AND s.blocked=0) AS available, (cr.owner_user_id=#{userId}) AS creator_owned FROM course_catalogue e JOIN learntrail_series s ON s.course_id=e.course_id JOIN course c ON c.id=e.course_id JOIN learntrail_creator cr ON cr.id=s.creator_id WHERE e.id=#{sectionId} AND e.type=2 AND e.deleted=0 AND c.deleted=0
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM learntrail_watchlist WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND series_id=#{seriesId}
DELETE FROM learntrail_creator_follow WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND creator_id=#{creatorId}
